values.description: A list of `Tensor` objects with the same shape and type.
constraints: axis must be within the valid range [-((params.values[0].rank)+1), (params.values[0].rank)+1)

axis.description: An `int`. The axis to stack along. Defaults to the first dimension. Negative values wrap around, so the valid range is `[-(R+1), R+1)`.
constraints: axis must be one of int
axis must be within the valid range [-((params.values[0].rank)+1), (params.values[0].rank)+1)

output.description: A stacked `Tensor` with the same type as `values`.

constraints: axis must be within the valid range [-((params.values[0].rank)+1), (params.values[0].rank)+1)
